title: Infer a CSV header from a headerless file
prompt: This CSV has no header row. Read the first 5 data rows and infer what the column names should be. The first column is a date (YYYY-MM-DD), the second is a product name, the third is a quantity (integer), the fourth is a price (decimal), and the fifth is a country code (2-letter). Write the inferred header as the first line of the file. Use snake_case for column names.
verify_command: head -1 data/sales_2024.csv | grep -q ',' && [ $(head -1 data/sales_2024.csv | awk -F',' '{print NF}') = 5 ]
quality_rubric: 1-5: header has 5 columns, snake_case, names match the obvious data

title: Add a Google-style docstring to a function
prompt: Add a Google-style docstring to the function `calculate_total` in src/billing.py. The docstring must include Args, Returns, and Raises sections. Use the function signature to infer parameter types and return type.
verify_command: grep -A 20 'def calculate_total' src/billing.py | grep -q 'Args:' && grep -A 20 'def calculate_total' src/billing.py | grep -q 'Returns:'
quality_rubric: 1-5: docstring has Args, Returns, Raises sections; types are accurate

title: Add unit tests for calculate_total covering happy path and edge cases
prompt: Add unit tests for the function `calculate_total` in src/billing.py to tests/test_billing.py. Add tests that cover the happy path and at least one edge case (empty items list, negative total raising ValueError, tax applied, etc). Output the COMPLETE new test_billing.py file with all tests — both the existing ones and the new ones you add.
verify_command: python -m pytest tests/test_billing.py -q 2>&1 | tail -1 | grep -qE '(passed|passed in)' && python -m pytest tests/test_billing.py --collect-only -q 2>&1 | grep -E 'test_' | wc -l | awk '{exit ($1 >= 4) ? 0 : 1}'
quality_rubric: 1-5: covers happy path, covers edge case, uses correct assertions

title: Refactor fetch_user to use the new get_user API method
prompt: Refactor the function `fetch_user` in src/users.py to use the new `client.get_user(user_id)` method instead of the old `client.fetch(endpoint=f'/users/{user_id}')` pattern. The function signature, docstring, and return type must stay the same. The existing test in tests/test_users.py must still pass.
quality_rubric: 1-5: tests pass, signature preserved, diff is minimal

title: Add a --verbose flag to the analyze CLI command
prompt: Add a `--verbose` flag to the `analyze` command in src/cli.py. When set, the command should print each path it processes before processing it. The existing tests in tests/test_cli.py must still pass. The behavior without --verbose must be unchanged.
verify_command: python -m pytest tests/test_cli.py -q 2>&1 | tail -1 | grep -q 'passed' && python -m src.cli analyze --help 2>&1 | grep -q -- '--verbose'
quality_rubric: 1-5: --verbose present in help, tests pass, minimal diff
